frontend.selection: typed select with bool condition and equal branch types
frontend.automatic_policy: profile-guided per-operation fast48/wide48/ieee64 selection for double arithmetic

storage_abi: slot-major raw 64-bit VF64 slots; integer and binary16/binary32 values occupy low bits as defined by VF64 v1
limitations: The source language is straight-line and has no loops, calls, pointer memory operations, atomics, or branches
CuMetal source/PTX double lowering does not call this frontend or emit VF64
CUDA-visible mov.b64, uint64_t, shared-memory, shuffle, reload, and call boundaries are not regression-tested through VF64
This artifact does not meet the M5 exit criterion
